tasks.title: Build `good-agent review`, the fresh read-only external reviewer
tasks.summary: A runner that spawns a fresh, read-only Codex or Claude Code review of a story, plan, design or diff, validates the findings against the schema, records digests and rounds, and returns the JSON, replacing Taproot's mailbox-and-watcher exchange.

tasks.title: Claim the npm names and set up the release workflow
tasks.summary: Publish `good-agent` (unscoped) as the package, `@taprootio/good-agent` as a thin alias, and copy Trellis's version-bump release workflow with trusted publishing.

tasks.title: Adopt good-agent in taproot and taproot-controls and remove the duplicates
tasks.summary: Point taproot and taproot-controls at the published skills and review runner, delete the process text and exchange scripts they duplicate, and fix the errors the guard reports in each repo.

tasks.title: Remove the work-task playbook from Trellis in favour of good-agent
tasks.summary: Once good-agent is released, delete Trellis's own work-task playbook and MCP prompt and point its code-review and pr-draft playbooks at good-agent's review-loop skill, so the loop has one home.

tasks.title: Build the guard (`good-agent check`) v0.1
tasks.summary: Ship the `good-agent` CLI with the nine v0.1 rules, canonical-file detection, config, human and JSON output, fixtures per rule, and the corpus script, as designed in docs/design.md.

tasks.title: Ship the instruction-hygiene skill and `init --skill`
tasks.summary: Write the `good-agent` SKILL.md that teaches an AI tool to set up and audit instruction files, and the `init --skill` command that installs it for Claude Code, Codex and Copilot.

tasks.title: Write the write-task and work-task playbooks with the review loop
tasks.summary: Capture Taproot's story-writing and task-working loops as universal good-agent playbooks (shipped as skills) with a shared review-loop section covering internal review until clean and external review by the other AI tool until clean.
